prerequisites: fresh world prepared by existing world prepare
physical client profile and new contract/epoch
EULA/launch permission and budget already granted
verified Linux X11 foreground client or separately supported driver

input.position: fresh bound viewport center in client-local integer pixels
input.identity: complete identity from the same binding and run contract
input.operation_id: fresh bounded unique ID for each intentional press

command_registry_template.equip_staff: item replace entity {invoking_player_uuid} weapon.mainhand with kneekura:celestial_staff 1

setup_constraints: Register the exact resolved equip_staff command before session creation; placeholders are not executable commands
Select a fresh controlled test player with no Glowing/cooldown and baseline full health; if effects or hazards exist, stop and use a new authorized fixture
Do not use effect, data merge, direct Item.use, scripted success flags, or a test command to satisfy the physical input assertion
Observe one non-invoking player separately for self-only effect evidence when a second player is available; otherwise that assertion remains NOT_RUN

steps.action: Read the six-task acceptance inputs and actual pinned staff source; capture fixed requirements before any change
Use existing asset capture/import; preserve exact manifest/model/texture hashes and do not overwrite the original source artifact
Run existing registered compile/export, import resolved inputs, compare package resources and prepare a fresh client contract; source edits invalidate old receipts
At each operator-confirmed inventory/first-person/third-person checkpoint call observe --operation client with the exact query; retain screenshot hash, camera, screen and intervals
Capture exact player UUID/dimension, health, main-hand staff/count/damage, absent Glowing and inactive cooldown before the first press
Use input bind, then exactly one scoped 50 ms physical mouse:right dispatch while actual gameplay screen is foreground; retain native receipt and its same-run pre/post evidence

Capture the selected player immediately after dispatch. If effect expired before the sample, keep this assertion inconclusive; do not change the 60-tick rule or infer behavior from dispatch completion

Only while authenticated observations show active cooldown and positive Glowing duration, issue a second separately identified physical press; observe monotonic effect/cooldown decrease within measured tick intervals. If the interval crosses expiry, result is inconclusive
Observe the effect gone and later cooldown inactive; exact 60/100-tick claims rely only on the fixed server GameTest, not sampled wall-clock delays

On a reproducible failed assertion, retain before evidence, repair source/asset, rebuild and recapture all identities, then rerun the same assertion/control scenario within the remaining approved launch budget. Never weaken an assertion to turn FAIL into PASS

assertions.requirement: Native press/release completes in the current bound foreground client and same epoch; command/handler invocation is insufficient
Initially unglowing invoking player gains minecraft:glowing amplifier 0 with positive duration <=60 after physical use; non-invoking control remains unchanged
While cooldown is known active, second press does not increase Glowing duration/amplifier or cooldown fraction; interval crossing expiration is inconclusive
Cooldown starts active and positive after use, decreases and eventually expires; exact 100 ticks remains server-only GameTest evidence
Same player health unchanged in hazard-free controlled baseline; attempted-damage behavior additionally covered by the negative GameTest
Main-hand item remains kneekura:celestial_staff with identical count and damage
Inventory icon is present with intended captured model/texture, readable staff silhouette and no missing texture
First-person staff shape, colors and hand placement match fixed captured asset and do not obscure normal aim
Third-person held staff and Glowing appearance are visible as intended in the observed camera/view
A separately connected client receives the server-authoritative state for the same player/build; singleplayer cannot PASS this assertion
Runtime client branch itself applies no effect/cooldown mutation; eventual synchronized effect presence cannot prove or disprove this

limitations: No launch, client interaction or compatibility execution is authorized by this scenario file
Snapshot intervals are non-atomic; do not invent tick-perfect synchronization or wall-clock timing
Dedicated synchronization and runtime client-only mutation require separate evidence; server GameTests and injected input fixtures cannot close them
Windows, Wayland and automated keyboard/view changes are not accepted by the selected Linux mouse:right route
Publish portable metadata and sanitized evidence only; retain private sessions and raw local receipts outside publication
